icon.$description: Component tier: tokens named per-component, for the cases a component needs a value distinct from its semantic default (BR-BW-TOK-001, tier 3). Theme-agnostic (they reference semantic colour tokens, which already resolve per theme, or fixed sizes). Most components consume semantic tokens directly and need nothing here; this set is deliberately small.

min-width.$description: Minimum width for dropdown-shaped panels (the account-menu panel is the first consumer).

value-size.$description: Stat tile numeral size (VIZ-001, AC-BW-075); a live var() reference so the font scale cascades, and the size modifiers re-point it per tile.

max-width.$description: 0.4.0 polish: was `none`. A default measure cap so content bands stop degrading into full-bleed wires on wide monitors; invisible at 1280px. A consumer overrides it (including back to `none`) to change the cap.

focus.$description: Focus-ring geometry (DESIGN.md section 6.4). An accessibility floor: not brand-tunable except via --bw-color-focus-ring.

z.$description: Stacking scale (DESIGN.md section 6.5). Chrome sits below overlay surfaces; dropdown content that opens inside the sticky topbar must not fight it.

font.$description: Typography tokens (semver-public, brand-overridable). Theme-agnostic. A consuming app rebrands its typeface the same token-first way it rebrands colour, by overriding --bw-font-family-* rather than reaching into brickwork's own classes. The default stack is a neutral system-font stack so an unbranded install still looks intentional.

sans.$value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'

mono.$value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
